pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page background, card surfaces, text on dark — the dominant canvas that makes muted accents feel deliberate

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, nav background, dark-band canvas, CTA fills — maximum contrast anchor

soft-mist.$description: Soft Mist — Secondary surface for elevated cards and section backgrounds, one step above canvas

pale-stone.$description: Pale Stone — Section band dividers, mobile nav close buttons, alternating rhythm breaks

bone.$description: Bone — Sub-surface for nested cards and decorative icon washes

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, helper copy, secondary descriptions — readable but recessed

smoke.$description: Smoke — Mid-tone panel surface for subdued dark UI layers and secondary containers. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Filled button background, dark surface panels — soft alternative to pure black

silhouette.$description: Silhouette — Outlined login button border — visible but never assertive

warm-sandstone.$description: Warm Sandstone — Earth-tone accent — large section surface tints and muted icon fills, used as a categorical color for one product vertical

forest-sovereignty.$description: Forest Sovereignty — Deep green accent — large feature surface and heading color for a categorical product vertical

dusty-iris.$description: Dusty Iris — Muted violet accent — categorical heading color and decorative iconography

slate-blue.$description: Slate Blue — Cool blue-gray accent — decorative SVG strokes and icon fills

aeonik.$description: Primary typeface across all UI — headings use weight 400 (anti-convention), body uses 400, emphasis labels use 500, uppercase link microcopy uses 600 with capitalize transform

mono.$description: Tertiary labels, tag pills, button microcopy — uppercase at 11px with +0.05em tracking, sentence-case at 13px with -0.01em
